MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.v3.Articl.description:
Represents time-based availability settings for articles.
This class enables the definition of complex availability schedules using month, day-of-week, and specific date rules.

MonthAvailabilities.description:
Defines availability based on months and days within those months.
Example: January 1-3,5-8; June 15-18

DayOfWeekAvailabilities.description:
Defines availability based on days of the week and time ranges.
Example: Monday 08:00-15:00, 20:00-23:00; Friday 10:00-15:00, 19:00-20:00;

SpecificDatesAvailabilities.description:
Defines availability based on specific dates and time ranges.
Example: 2024-01-01  08:00-15:00, 20:00-23:00; 2025-01-01 10:00-15:00;

If it is "ArticleGroup", then the article group is defined by the ArticleGroupId property.

The group can be fetched using the v2/groups/{Id} endpoint.

Represents the data structure used to create a new order.
This class specifies the required information for creating an order within the system.

ExternalReference.description:
The external reference or order number from another system.
This is a required field.

UpdateOnExisting.description: Indicates whether to update an existing order if one with the same number already exists.

Customer.description:
Information about the customer associated with the order.
Either a customer number within the system or an external customer reference. This is a required field.

BillingAddress.description: The billing address for the order, if different from the customer's default address.

ShippingAddress.description: The shipping address for the order, if different from the customer's default address.

IncomingDate.description: The date when the order was received.

StartDate.description: The start date for the order (e.g., for a service).

ReadyDate.description: The date when the order is expected to be ready.

ExpireDate.description: The date when the order expires (if applicable).

DeliveryDate.description: The date when the order is scheduled for delivery.

YourReference.description: The reference provided by the customer or the customer's system.

DeliveryTerm.description: The delivery terms for the order.

YourOrderNo.description: The customer's order number or other identifier.

Note.description: A note or comment associated with the order.

Discount.description: The discount applied to the order, expressed as a percentage.

TotalExclVat.description: The total amount of the order, excluding VAT.

TotalInclVat.description: The total amount of the order, including VAT.

PaymentStatus.description: The status of the payment for the order.

ExternalReference.description:

ShippingAddress.description: The shipping address for the order, if different from the customer's default address.

ReadyDate.description: The date when the order is expected to be ready for pickup or delivery.

YourReference.description: The reference provided by the customer or an external system for the order.

DeliveryTerm.description: The delivery terms for the order.

Note.description: A general note or comment associated with the order.

TotalExclVat.description: The total amount of the order, excluding VAT.

Rows.description: A list of rows containing details about the items included in the order.

This encapsulates a ReceiptGet object and its unique identifier, typically used in API responses related to retrieving or managing receipt data.

A list of extra information or messages related to the API operation result.
This can include error messages, warnings, or informational notes.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents a receipt, extending the base Receipt class with the UTC creation timestamp.
This class is used to return receipt data, including all standard receipt information and the time when the receipt was created in UTC.

CreatedTimeUTC.description: The UTC timestamp when the receipt was created.

Origin.description:
The origin of the receipt.
This should identify the source of the receipt, such as the serial number of a cashier or a descriptive name like "Cashier 1".

Id.description:
The unique identifier of the receipt.
This cannot be set externally and is generated by the system.

InternalNote.description:
An internal note associated with the receipt.
This note is not printed on the receipt.

TransactionDate.description: The date and time when the receipt transaction was made.

CashierName.description:
The name of the cashier who completed the receipt.
This represents the sales person on the receipt.

TotalPriceIncVat.description: The total price of the receipt, including VAT and all discounts.

TotalPriceExVat.description: The total price of the receipt, excluding VAT but including all discounts.

TotalVat.description: The total VAT amount for the receipt, including all discounts.

DoStockMgmt.description:
Defines if stock management should be performed for articles on the receipt.
If this is a normal sale and DoStockMgmt is TRUE, then the stock quantity of all articles on the receipt will be decreased according to their quantity.

Rounding.description:
Information about any rounding applied to the receipt total.
For example, if 10.50 SEK is rounded to 11.00 SEK, then the rounding is 0.5 SEK.

ControlUnit.description:
Information about the control unit used in the receipt transaction.
This is legally required in some regions for ordinary cashiers.

Customers.description:
A list of customers associated with the receipt.
Normally, there should only be one customer, but sometimes a ContractCustomer is also relevant.

Articles.description: A list of all articles included in the receipt.

Payments.description: A list of all payment methods used in the receipt.

Vat.description: A list of all VAT types applied in the receipt.

Orders.description: A list of order references from which articles may originate.

Discounts.description: A list of all discounts applied to the receipt.

Recipients.description: A list of recipients if the receipt is to be sent to an end customer via email or SMS.

TextRows.description: A list of any additional text rows to be printed on the receipt.

ClientDetails.description: Client details, required for receipts originating from a Cashier when ReceiptType is set to CashierReceipt.

Voucher.description:
Accounting details.
If this receipt should be bookkept, this section contains voucher information for creating the voucher.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description: Represents merchant information, including identification, contact details, and address.

CorporateIdentityNumber.description: The corporate identity number of the merchant (e.g., SSN, Organization number).

Name.description: The name of the company or merchant.

AddressLine1.description: The first line of the merchant's address.

AddressLine2.description: The second line of the merchant's address (optional).

ZipCode.description: The postal code of the merchant's address.

City.description: The city of the merchant's address.

Country.description: The country of the merchant's address.

Phone.description: The merchant's landline or cell phone number.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents the rounding applied to the total amount of a receipt.
This class encapsulates information about the adjustment made to the receipt total due to rounding to a specific denomination.

Amount.description: The total rounding amount applied to the receipt.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents a tax control unit and its associated control code.
This class encapsulates information about a tax control unit, including its unique identifier and the control code it provides.

UnitId.description: The unit identifier of the tax control unit.

ControlCode.description: The control code received from the tax control unit.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents customer information.
This class encapsulates data related to a customer, including their customer number, name, and customer type.

CompanyName.description: The company name, if the customer is a company.

Fullname.description: The full name of the customer.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description: Represents an article within a receipt or order, containing details about the item purchased or sold.

OrderIndex.description: The index of this article within the order specified in the Receipt.Order.

ArticleNumber.description: The article number, which may not necessarily be numeric.

Name.description: The name of the article, suitable for display and printing.

Quantity.description:
The quantity of the article.
Quantity is always positive, even in the case of a refund purchase.

UnitPrice.description:
The price of a single unit of this article, including VAT.
Must be negative in the case of a refund purchase.

VatRate.description: The VAT rate applied to the article.

TotalPriceIncVat.description:
The total price of the article, including VAT and all applicable discounts.
Must be negative in the case of a refund purchase.

TotalPriceExVat.description:
The total price of the article, excluding VAT and including all applicable discounts.
Must be negative in the case of a refund purchase.

TotalVat.description:
The total VAT amount for the article, including all applicable discounts.
Must be negative in the case of a refund purchase.

Discounts.description: A list of discounts applied to the article.

Attributes.description: A list of attributes associated with the article.

TextRows.description: A list of text rows associated with the article.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents a payment within a transaction.
This class encapsulates information about a payment, including its name, amount, type, and transaction details.

Name.description:
The name of the payment method, intended for display on a receipt.
This is not a technical name.

TransactionId.description: The transaction identifier, if the payment is integrated and generates a transaction ID.

TransactionOrigin.description: The technical name of a payment integration.

AppsTransaction.description: Details for an AppsCardPayment, if PaymentType is set to AppsCardPayment.

BankCardTransaction.description: Details for a BankCardPayment, if PaymentType is set to BankCardPayment.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents VAT (Value Added Tax) information within a receipt.
This class encapsulates details about a specific VAT rate applied in the transaction, including the rate, total VAT amount, and total purchase amount.

TotalVat.description: The total VAT amount on the receipt for the given VatRate.

TotalAmount.description:
The total purchase amount for the given VatRate on the receipt.

Example:
A receipt contains one article priced 5 SEK, with 25% VAT.
In this case:
VatRate = 25.0
TotalVat = 1.0
TotalAmount = 5.0

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents a reference to an order within a receipt.
This class encapsulates information about an order reference, including its index, order number, origin, and state change.

Index.description:
The unique index (0-based) of the order reference within the OrderReference list in a receipt.
Articles on the receipt may refer to an order using this index number. This is a required field.

OrderNumber.description: The order number. This is a required field.

Origin.description: The type of origin or source, if the article originates from an order handout. This is a required field.

OrderChangeState.description: Specifies if the order state should be changed.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents a discount applied to a receipt.
This class encapsulates information about a discount that affects the overall transaction, including its type, amount, and description.

Amount.description:
The total amount of the receipt discount.
This value must be calculated from the percentage discount value and should represent the actual monetary reduction.
Remember that this discount must be distributed across all articles on the receipt, affecting their TotalPriceIncVat, TotalPriceExVat, and VatRate attributes.

Description.description: A descriptive text of the discount, intended for printing on the receipt.

Percentage.description: The percentage value of this receipt discount, if applicable.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents a recipient of a receipt, specifying the delivery method and contact information.
This class encapsulates information about how a receipt should be sent to a customer, either by email or SMS.

Carrier.description: Specifies the carrier used to send the receipt, either Email or SMS.

EmailAddress.description: The email address of the recipient, if the Carrier is Email.

MobilePhone.description: The mobile phone number of the recipient, if the Carrier is SMS.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description:
Represents a text row to be printed on a receipt, either in the header or footer.
This class encapsulates information about a single line of text that should appear on a receipt, including its type (header/footer), position, and content.

RowType.description:
Specifies whether the text row is part of the header or footer.
Valid values are defined by the TextRowType enum.

RowNum.description: The row number of this text within the header or footer, used for ordering.

Text.description: The text content of the row.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Receipts..description: Client details of cash register, only set by MoreFlo Cash registers.

ClientId.description: Client ID, id of cash register.

MoreFlo.Models.InterfaceModels.Voucher.description:
Represents a voucher, which is a document used for accounting purposes.
This class encapsulates information about a voucher, including its identification, state, accounting details, and related rows.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the voucher.

UpdateOnExisting.description:
Indicates whether an update should be performed during creation if a voucher with the same Id already exists.
This is only applicable to voucher update API calls.

SupportingNumber.description: A supporting number for the voucher, set by the system.

VoucherNumber.description:
The verification number assigned by the external accounting system.
Set by the system if the voucher is synchronized with an external accounting system.

VoucherSeries.description:
The verification series assigned by the external accounting system.
Set by the system if the voucher is synchronized with an external accounting system.

IsDeleted.description:
A flag indicating if this supporting voucher is marked as deleted.
This is only relevant for voucher updates.

State.description: The current state of the voucher.

ErrorReason.description: The reason for an error if synchronization with an external system failed.

IsBookkept.description:
A flag indicating if this supporting voucher has been recorded in an external accounting system.
If true, the voucher will not be synchronized again.

VoucherSyncReference.description: A name or other reference to the external accounting system.

VoucherSyncTime.description: The timestamp of when this supporting voucher was recorded in the external accounting system.

This class encapsulates information about a ticket order, including order details, customer information, dates, and payment information.

The order identifier from an external system.
Must be set when creating the order.

Information about the customer who placed the order.
Can be either a CustomerNumber within the system or a ReferenceNumber from an external system.

Note.description: A general note about the order.

State.description: The current state of the order.

Rows.description: A list of rows containing details about the tickets in the order.

BillingAddress.description: The billing address for the order.

ShippingAddress.description: The shipping address for the order.

PaymentReference.description: A reference related to the payment for the order.

PaymentOption.description: The payment option selected for the order.

PaymentOrigin.description: Information about the origin of the payment.

PaymentStatus.description: The payment status of the order.
